settings.title: How It Works
settings.step_1_detail: Your protocol is designed as a structured, nature-aligned regimen tailored to your selected goals, preferences, and daily physiology. Begin by following your prescribed schedule with consistency, allowing your system time to adapt and establish baseline equilibrium.
settings.step_2_detail: The primary objective during this phase is adherence and integration. Incorporate your protocol into your existing daily routine in a way that is sustainable, predictable, and minimally disruptive. Consistency is more important than intensity.
settings.step_3_detail: As you progress through the month, observe how your routine interacts with your energy, digestion, recovery, and overall daily function. Maintain what is working well, make measured adjustments when necessary, and remain anchored to your long-term objectives.

settings.heading: Initiation & Physiologic Adaptation
settings.detail: Begin your protocol and allow your body to enter a period of gentle adaptation. Focus on consistency, timing, and establishing a stable daily cadence.

settings.heading: Consolidation of Routine
settings.detail: At this stage, the protocol should begin to feel more familiar. Continue with steady adherence, reinforcing behavioral consistency and supporting physiologic normalization.

settings.heading: Find Your Rhythm
settings.detail: Continue following your protocol and build on the consistency you've established. Use this time to evaluate your routine, track how you're feeling, and stay focused on your goals.

settings.heading: Clinical Review & Forward Planning
settings.detail: You have completed the initial 30-day cycle. At this point, evaluate your subjective experience, adherence quality, and alignment with your intended outcomes. Use these insights to determine the appropriate next phase of your SPADRA protocol.

settings.title: Built between two homes.
settings.body:
SPADRA comes out of an American and Nepalese Himalayan household — two traditions that agree on very little except this: look after the body daily, and do not make a performance of it.

From one side, the habit of asking what the evidence actually says. From the other, an inherited patience — that steadiness outlasts intensity, and a practice you keep is worth more than one you admire. We try to hold both, with respect for every tradition that arrived at them long before we did.

In practice that looks unglamorous. Every ingredient in your protocol is pre-sorted into one daily pouch at its clinical dose. No counting, no cabinet of half-finished bottles. One pouch, every day, done.

settings.heading: Designed for optimal bioavailability
settings.body: Every active is selected for purity and clinical dosing — real vitamin forms, bioavailable minerals, standardized botanicals. Manufacturing is handled by OKCapsule, our packing partner, so every pouch is filled and sealed to the same standard.
settings.standards_items: cGMP-certified facility: manufactured under current Good Manufacturing Practice requirements|Third-party tested: potency and purity checked by an outside lab on a skip-lot basis|Evidence-based dosing: actives dosed at levels drawn from published research, not proprietary blends|No unnecessary fillers: nothing added to a formula that is not doing something in it

settings.question: Is SPADRA a replacement for my prescription medication?
settings.answer: No. SPADRA supplement packs are not a substitute for prescription medication and should be used with your healthcare provider. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

settings.question: How does Subscribe & Save work?
settings.answer: Choose monthly delivery instead of a one-time purchase at checkout and your protocol arrives every 30 days at a standing discount — the exact saving is shown on each product page. You can skip a month, change the date, or cancel from your account at any time, and nothing is locked in beyond the order you have already placed.

settings.question: How do I know which pack is right for me?
settings.answer: Take the Find Your Protocol assessment — you can select more than one goal, and it will show you a protocol for each one along with a note on how they fit together. Or browse every protocol directly. If you're unsure, check with your provider.

settings.question: How long does one pack last?
settings.answer: Every protocol ships as a 30-day supply — one pre-sorted pouch per day. Buy it once, or set up monthly delivery so the next cycle arrives before you run out.

settings.question: How is it shipped?
settings.answer: Protocols ship in plain outer packaging with no product names or claims printed on the outside. Nothing on the box indicates what is inside.

settings.question: Are these products FDA approved?
settings.answer: SPADRA products are dietary supplements. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
